enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Dexterity +2: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Dexterity.

Balance +15: Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Balance skill.
Captain's Set: While wearing both items from the Captain's Set, you gain: +1 Quality bonus to Strength
The Devil's Handiwork: While wearing any five items from the The Devil's Handiwork, you gain: +2 Quality bonus to all Ability stats
